prompt: Implement `allocate(total, weights)` in solution.py: split the integer `total` (an amount in cents) across the weights so that the parts are integers summing exactly to `total`. Each part starts as the floor of its exact proportional share of the absolute value of `total`; the cents left over are handed out one each to the parts with the largest fractional remainders, ties going to the earlier position. For a negative total, allocate the absolute value and negate every part. Weights are non-negative ints and a zero weight always receives 0. The result is a list in the order of the weights and must be exact for arbitrarily large integers. Raise ValueError if `weights` is empty, any weight is negative, or all weights are zero; raise TypeError if `total` or any weight is not an int (bool is rejected too).
acceptance: parts sum exactly to the total
leftover cents go to the largest remainders, earlier position first
negative totals mirror the positive allocation
